context: Gates are green and runbooks are current. Proceed to mass Alfa production with an initial seed batch to establish daily cadence and throughput baselines.

directives.details: Freeze current Alfa templates/runbooks as baseline for this batch (record template/version in report).
Create 5 Alfa instances from baseline. Assign stable IDs and record mapping (ID → path).
Wire each instance to the shared exchange hub; verify wrappers (readiness/heartbeat/sync) present.
Run readiness + minimal smoke for each instance; capture logs under each instance’s logs/ and summarise results.
For each instance, stage a short ‘hello’ completion report to outbox/reports with evidence paths.
Sync staged artifacts to hub and append a ledger note summarising Batch 1 seeding (IDs, count, any exceptions).
Return a factory-report summarising the batch (throughput, issues, follow-ups) with links to instance reports.

success_criteria: 5 instances created from the frozen baseline with recorded IDs
Readiness + minimal smoke executed and summarised per instance
Hello reports staged and synced to hub
Ledger entry recorded for Batch 1 seeding
Factory completion report filed with evidence
